policies.identity: Source SHA-256 identifies the original supplied object. Public JPEG SHA-256 identifies the sanitized access image. Filename suffixes are source hash prefixes, not work identifiers.
policies.candidate_relationships: Candidate placements and assistant visual matches remain provisional. Their target IDs do not assign new work identity.
policies.recording_relationships: A recording may document several drawings; a drawing may appear in several recordings. Independent record-photo associations do not imply shared work identity, an exact recording segment, or final-state equality.
policies.source_preference: The owner-designated new_protocol collection is preferred for review. Source preference does not confirm drawing identity, photographed state, or optical quality.
policies.quality: Pixel dimensions, file size and container type do not certify focus, readable fine detail, complete coverage, faithful color, or a final drawing state.
policies.publication_scope: Additive reference photographs. All 435 previously selected current fronts remain unchanged. Unresolved placements and supplementary context photographs are retained with their qualifications.
policies.privacy_processing: Only the primary JPEG coding data, original ICC profile, and EXIF Orientation are retained. GPS, camera/device metadata, other EXIF, MakerNotes, XMP, MPF, comments, auxiliary images, and trailing data are removed. Original source objects are unchanged.
